name: peasants-running-kit-root
description: Peasants Running Kit full-stack application root workspace

scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 npm run dev
scripts.dev:emulator: npm run kill-ports && npx -y concurrently@^9 --names "EMULATOR,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run emulator" "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.test:unit: cd backend && npm test && cd ../app && npm test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:e2e && npm run lint:terraform
scripts.lint:fix: cd backend && npm run lint:fix && cd ../app && npm run lint:fix && cd .. && eslint --fix "e2e/**/*.ts" "playwright*.ts" && terraform fmt -recursive infrastructure
